svg.title: BIST30 Portföy Optimizasyonu
svg.desc: Postcard for BIST30 Portföy Optimizasyonu (thesis · flask web app, Python): Graduation thesis: forecasts return and risk for BIST 30 stocks with ARIMA, GARCH and LSTM, then builds optimal portfolios. ARIMA, GARCH, Black–Litterman and LSTM forecasts. Monte Carlo portfolios for three risk profiles. Weekly forecasts, macro signals, user vs AI board. Built with Python, Flask, TensorFlow, ARIMA & GARCH, scikit-learn, SQLite.
